title: Waiting for Fresh Fixer
story: The darkroom allotted each member ninety minutes, and Sunday's sheet was full when Helen arrived with a river roll. The fixing tray was cloudy because the chemical was exhausted, and no fresh bottle remained. Rui said a delivery would come on Tuesday. Helen could use the weak fixer and risk stained prints, or she could wait. She waited, because the negatives were the sole record of a bridge scheduled for demolition. Rui let her reserve the first Sunday after the delivery and wrote her name in ink so the slot could not be quietly taken. He taught her a precaution: test a tray with a strip of film before trusting it with a real roll. A ruined roll could not be restored by enthusiasm. Helen left the canister on the hold shelf and went home with no prints at all.

quiz.question: When did Rui expect the replacement chemical to arrive?
options: On Tuesday
That same Sunday
After the bridge came down
Once Helen had made a print

quiz.question: Where did Helen leave the canister before going home?
options: On the hold shelf
In the cloudy fixing tray
In Rui's delivery bag
Beside the river

quiz.question: What does Helen's choice to wait suggest about her priority?
options: Protecting the only pictures of the bridge mattered more than speed
She had decided to give up photography
She expected the town to record the bridge
She wanted the finished prints to look stained
quiz.correctAnswer: Protecting the only pictures of the bridge mattered more than speed
quiz.explanation: She waited because those negatives were the only record of a bridge due for demolition.
quiz.supportingSentence: She waited, because the negatives were the sole record of a bridge scheduled for demolition.

quiz.question: What does exhausted mean when it describes the chemical?
options: Used up and no longer strong enough
Mixed fresh on that same morning
Held back for another member
Locked away in an office cupboard
quiz.correctAnswer: Used up and no longer strong enough
quiz.explanation: The tray was cloudy because the chemical was exhausted and no fresh bottle remained.
quiz.supportingSentence: The fixing tray was cloudy because the chemical was exhausted, and no fresh bottle remained.

quiz.question: Why does the writer include the test with a strip of film?
options: To show how to check a tray before risking a real roll
To prove Helen had already spoiled three rolls
To explain why the darkroom was closing forever
To argue that walking should replace printing
quiz.correctAnswer: To show how to check a tray before risking a real roll
quiz.explanation: Rui's precaution is a test strip, so a weak tray can be caught before a real roll is ruined.
quiz.supportingSentence: He taught her a precaution: test a tray with a strip of film before trusting it with a real roll.
